# Findable

> Small business SEO services and AI visibility. We help businesses rank on Google, show up in ChatGPT, and get found in every AI search — with zero ad spend.

## About

Findable is a local SEO and AI visibility service operated by Phillip Krzankowski, SEO consultant and founder of DELTASEVEN.IO, LLC. We provide affordable SEO services for small businesses — helping them get found on Google Search, Google Maps, and AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Siri.

We are not an SEO agency or SEO company. We are an SEO specialist who works directly with each client. Every strategy we use is one we've tested on our own business first. Our approach has produced enormous organic growth through search engine optimization alone — no Google Pay-Per-Click, no paid advertising, no ad spend.

## Services

- **Google Visibility (Local SEO Services)**: Search engine optimization to help small businesses rank higher in Google Search, Google Maps, and "near me" results. We improve your Google ranking through organic search strategies, not paid ads.
- **AI Visibility (AI SEO / GEO)**: Generative engine optimization and answer engine optimization to ensure your business shows up in AI-generated responses from ChatGPT, Gemini, Siri, and other AI assistants.
- **Free SEO Consultation**: 15-minute consultation to assess your current Google ranking, online marketing presence, and AI visibility.

## Results

Our first client, deltaseven.io (math tutoring), saw these results in under 90 days after a single round of SEO optimization with zero ad spend:

- 16 new clients from organic Google search
- 5 referrals from ChatGPT
- 10+ Google search terms ranking
- 9 five-star Google reviews

## How It Works

1. Free consultation
2. We build your SEO and AI visibility
3. You get found

Most clients are live in 1–2 weeks. After launch, we monitor your Google rankings, track organic traffic, and keep everything optimized. Month-to-month engagement — no long-term contracts. Affordable SEO packages for small business.
